verdict.rationale: Namecheap's official Go SDK documents a CheckWithContext call that checks availability of one or more domains. It wraps a live XML API endpoint with a sandbox counterpart, so code or an agent can query availability programmatically. However, the pack contains no first-party API reference page for the check command and nothing on rate limits. Missing for 10: documented rate limits/quotas, a direct API reference for the domains check command, independent or hands-on corroboration.
